name: Joint Root-Finding
aliases: Joint Root-Finding — Simultaneous Ray-Surface and Correspondence Search
definition: A novel algorithm for simultaneous ray-surface intersection search and correspondence search, enabling efficient point sampling and accurate point canonicalization while generalizing well to unseen poses.
summary: Joint Root-Finding simultaneously solves for ray-surface intersection and geometric correspondence in articulated implicit surfaces, avoiding the high costs of alternating sphere tracing and root finding.
